decision: No authenticated cross-series donor equivalence or subtype transfer. Shared study drug and numerical patient labels are insufficient. GSE313859 donors010/011/012 remain individually histology unresolved; potential overlap is retained as an independence gap.
prior_title: Single-cell RNA-sequencing of undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, myxofibrosarcoma, and liposarcoma samples from patients participating in a clinical trial studying BO-112 plus Nivolumab and hypofractionated pre-operative radiotherapy.
prior_summary: Here we analyzed through single cell RNA sequencing multiple samples derived from patients with three different types of soft tissue sarcoma, including liposarcoma, undifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma, and myxofibrosarcoma, participating in a clinical trial that evaluates the efficacy of intra-tumoral BO-112 injection with or without Nivolumab and pre-operative radiation therapy. The goal of this study is to analyze the changes in the tumor-microenvironment associated with the treatments administered.
accessible_primary_metadata_limit: An indexed official GEO accession page states GSE279852 has nine patients in three named non-EMC sarcoma subtypes and is submitted by Beth Israel Deaconess; GSE313859 SOFT identifies Stanford contact and NCT04420975, but neither source gives a cross-series donor ID table. Direct official GEO web open returned a browser check; no CAPTCHA/login/alternate content bypass attempted.
scope: Eligibility and independence challenge only. No expression values inspected, no EMC disease inference, no new paper.
